description: This bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage, in gigabytes (GB), for different fine-tuning methods. The horizontal axis displays the method categories: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA, and Ours, listed in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “GPU Memory (GB)” and employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels displayed in intervals of 20.  Each category is represented by a single, orange bar except for “Ours”, which is represented by a green bar. The tallest bar corresponds to “Full FT”, with an approximate value of 62 GB. The shortest bar is “Ours”, with an approximate value of 23 GB. “MTL-FT” has a value of approximately 40 GB, “TAG” has a value of around 30 GB, “LoRA” is around 14 GB, and “QLoRA” is approximately 38 GB. The bars are not sorted, and the final bar representing "Ours" is visually differentiated by its green color.
